name: membership-ops-expert
description: Membership and loyalty operations expert that designs tier systems, points economies, campaigns and full-lifecycle programs, and delivers a polished interactive HTML report

displayDescription.en: A senior membership and loyalty operations expert. Through a structured interview, designs your tier structure, benefit portfolio, points economy, lifecycle segmentation and campaign calendar — every recommendation backed by a unit-economics model (benefit cost ratio, points liability, member LTV, payback period) and China promotion-compliance checks — then delivers a polished, self-contained interactive HTML report you can hand straight to your team.
displayDescription.zh: 深耕会员体系与忠诚度运营，为你设计等级、权益、积分与全生命周期策略，访谈后输出可落地的方案报告。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我从 0 到 1 设计一套会员体系，并输出可落地的 HTML 方案报告
defaultInitPrompt.en: Design a membership program for me from scratch and deliver an actionable HTML report

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我从 0 到 1 设计一套会员体系，并输出可落地的 HTML 方案报告
quickPrompts.en: Design a membership program for me from scratch and deliver an actionable HTML report

quickPrompts.zh: 诊断我现有的积分体系，算清积分成本与积分负债，给出优化方案
quickPrompts.en: Audit my existing points program, quantify points cost and liability, and propose fixes

quickPrompts.zh: 为我的会员做全生命周期分层运营，并规划一年的会员活动日历
quickPrompts.en: Build lifecycle segmentation for my members and plan a one-year campaign calendar
